listen_port.description: UDP port to listen on for incoming broadcast/multicast packets.

enable_ipv6.description: Whether to enable IPv6 support for listening and relaying.

max_packet_size.description: Maximum size in bytes of packets to accept and relay. Larger packets are dropped.

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads to process incoming packets (1–32).

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to bind to. Use ['any'] to listen on all interfaces.

items.description: Network interface name (e.g., eth0, enp3s0, or 'any').

destinations.description: List of relay destinations (IP addresses or hostnames). Optional per-destination port.

port.description: Optional destination port (if omitted, uses same as listen_port).

rate_limit_pps.description: Maximum packets per second to relay per source IP. Set to 0 to disable rate limiting.

pidfile.description: Path to write the daemon's PID file.

drop_privileges.description: Whether to drop root privileges after opening the listening port.

privilege_user.description: System user to drop to when privileges are enabled.

privilege_group.description: System group to drop to when privileges are enabled.
